Shanghai Municipal Council.

December 21st 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
On December 20th at the Rifle Range bombs removed from the following places were experimented upon with rifle fire:-
(1) Large black enamelled tin canister removed from the Commercial Press Building on Honan Road on December 19th. This tin must have contained a very strong explosive as it went off with terrific force when pierced by a rifle bullet. It was apparently intended that the person discovering it should open it as a quantity of tea and paper was placed on the top to excite the curiosity of the person seeing it and cause him to look further into the contents when no doubt it would have gone off.
(2) Cylindrical metal bomb removed from No.22 Wayside Road on December 3rd 1916. There was a slight explosion only when this was pierced. The force of the explosive had apparently been destroyed by its being soaked in water for over a fortnight.
(3) Cylindrical shaped metal bomb found in the garden at No.26 Wei Hai Wei Road on September 20th 1916. This exploded with great force and scattered fragments of metal all over the ground in the vicinity.
(4) Bomb with case made of a cigarette tin brought from 181/2 Peking Road on 21-7-16. The explosion in this case was slight due to the powder have been soaked by the immersion of the bomb in water.
(5) Bomb with case made of tin canister brought from 200 Hupeh Road on 5-11-16. The explosion was slight due to immersion in water.
(6) Tin canister brought from the Ta Woo Dae 大舞台 theatre on 12,10-16 supposed to be filled with explosives contained earth only.
(7) Two small tin canisters found in the Kiukiang Road theatre on 8-12-16 and supposed to be filled with explosives were filled with mud only.

Your Obedient Servant,
mcarmstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

OM
Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。

1916年12月21日

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

先生：

12月20日，在靶场对从下列地点移走的炸弹进行了步枪射击试验：-

(1) 12月19日从河南路商务印书馆大楼移走的一个大型黑色搪瓷锡罐。该锡罐内必定装有威力极强的炸药，因为被步枪子弹击穿时发生了猛烈的爆炸。显然，放置者意图让发现者打开它，因为在顶部放置了一些茶叶和纸张，以激起看到它的人的好奇心，并促使其进一步查看内部物品，届时无疑会发生爆炸。

(2) 1916年12月3日从韦思德路（Wayside Road）22号移走的一个圆柱形金属炸弹。该炸弹被击穿时仅发生轻微爆炸。由于在水中浸泡了超过两周，其炸药的威力显然已被破坏。

(3) 1916年9月20日在威海卫路26号花园内发现的一个圆柱形金属炸弹。该炸弹发生猛烈爆炸，金属碎片散落在附近的地面上。

(4) 1916年7月21日从北京路181/2号带来的一个以香烟盒为外壳的炸弹。由于炸弹浸水导致火药受潮，此次爆炸威力轻微。

(5) 1916年11月5日从湖北路200号带来的一个以锡罐为外壳的炸弹。由于浸水，爆炸威力轻微。

(6) 1916年10月12日从大舞台剧院带来的一个锡罐，据信装满了炸药，但里面只装有泥土。

(7) 1916年12月8日在九江路剧院发现的两个小锡罐，据信装满了炸药，但里面只装有泥浆。

您顺从的仆人，
mcarmstrong
总探长。

OM
警务处总监
